<?php
class CountriesApi {
    public function handle() {
        return $this->byName($this->request['name']);
    }
    private function byName($name) {
        $where = " WHERE country = '$name' ";
        return $this->run($where);
    }
    private function run($where = '') {
        return $this->db->query("SELECT id, country FROM country $where");
    }
}
